reference_sql:
WITH paid_0 AS (  -- one row per user with a payment that was not refunded in the signup month
  SELECT DISTINCT u.user_id
  FROM signups u
  JOIN subscriptions s ON s.user_id = u.user_id
  JOIN payments p ON p.subscription_id = s.subscription_id
  WHERE NOT p.refunded
    AND date_trunc('month', p.paid_at) = date_trunc('month', u.signup_ts)
)
SELECT CAST(date_trunc('month', u.signup_ts) AS DATE) AS cohort_month,
       COUNT(*) AS cohort_users,
       COUNT(z.user_id) AS paid_month_0
FROM signups u
LEFT JOIN paid_0 z ON z.user_id = u.user_id
WHERE u.signup_ts >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2024-01-01 00:00:00+00' AND u.signup_ts < TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-01-01 00:00:00+00'
GROUP BY cohort_month
alternatives:
SELECT CAST(date_trunc('month', u.signup_ts) AS DATE) AS cohort_month,
       COUNT(DISTINCT u.user_id) AS cohort_users,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.payment_id IS NOT NULL THEN u.user_id END) AS paid_month_0
FROM signups u
LEFT JOIN subscriptions s ON s.user_id = u.user_id
LEFT JOIN payments p
  ON p.subscription_id = s.subscription_id
 AND p.refunded = false
 AND date_trunc('month', p.paid_at) = date_trunc('month', u.signup_ts)
WHERE u.signup_ts >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2024-01-01 00:00:00+00' AND u.signup_ts < TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-01-01 00:00:00+00'
GROUP BY 1

SELECT CAST(date_trunc('month', u.signup_ts) AS DATE) AS cohort_month,
       COUNT(*) AS cohort_users,
       SUM(CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM subscriptions s
                             JOIN payments p ON p.subscription_id = s.subscription_id
                             WHERE s.user_id = u.user_id AND NOT p.refunded
                               AND date_diff('month', u.signup_ts, p.paid_at) = 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS paid_month_0
FROM signups u
WHERE date_part('year', u.signup_ts) = 2024
GROUP BY 1

other_way.sql:

       COUNT(*) AS cohort_users,
       SUM(CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM subscriptions s
                             JOIN payments p ON p.subscription_id = s.subscription_id
                             WHERE s.user_id = u.user_id AND NOT p.refunded
                               AND date_diff('month', u.signup_ts, p.paid_at) = 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS paid_month_0
FROM signups u
WHERE date_part('year', u.signup_ts) = 2024
GROUP BY 1
other_way.tradeoff: EXISTS asks once per user whether a month 0 payment exists, so no user is counted twice, but it is longer to write.

solver.query:
WITH c AS (
  SELECT user_id, CAST(date_trunc('month', timezone('UTC', signup_ts)) AS DATE) AS cm FROM signups
  WHERE signup_ts >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2024-01-01 00:00:00+00' AND signup_ts < TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-01-01 00:00:00+00'
),
p AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT s.user_id, CAST(date_trunc('month', timezone('UTC', pay.paid_at)) AS DATE) AS pm
  FROM subscriptions s JOIN payments pay ON pay.subscription_id = s.subscription_id
  WHERE NOT pay.refunded
)
SELECT c.cm AS cohort_month, COUNT(*) AS cohort_users, COUNT(p.user_id) AS paid_month_0
FROM c LEFT JOIN p ON p.user_id = c.user_id AND p.pm = c.cm
GROUP BY 1
